skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and evaluate past and current developments in socio-economic forecasting.
Apply quantitative methods to forecast socio-economic trends.
Conduct qualitative analysis to predict future trends in socio-economic forecasting.
Use statistical and econometric software to estimate models and perform forecasts.
Apply forecasting results in policy management and planning.
Collaborate effectively in group settings, presenting and discussing professional content.
Develop a habit of self-study and continuous learning in socio-economic forecasting.
Understand professional ethics and social responsibility in socio-economic forecasting.
